summary: Iteration 66 — verified the new 'Claim task deadlines' notification group (added this session) on the Expo web preview (390x844) for ryan@ryan.com. NOTIFICATIONS section on More tab (bottom-nav label 'VAULT') was inspected end-to-end and the claim task-with-deadline data flow on /insurance-claims/<id> was validated. Master 'Allow notifications' toggle: present (testID toggle-notifications-master). With master ON + claim_task_notifications_enabled=true, the new group 'Claim task deadlines' renders ALONGSIDE the existing three groups (Dealer route reminders, Borrowed-tool overdue reminders, Payment Notifications) and is followed by the 'Send a test notification' row — no regression to the existing rows. The group exposes all three required testIDs: notif-claimtask-toggle-row, toggle-claimtask-notifications, notif-claimtask-time-row. Toggling the 'Claim task deadlines' switch OFF correctly removes the 'Reminder time' and 'Also remind day before' sub-rows; toggling it back ON restores them. Tapping 'Reminder time' on web did NOT throw and did NOT crash (the iOS Modal isn't rendered because Platform.OS==='web' — expected per the spec). 'Also remind day before' toggle renders for the new group (3 'Also remind day before' rows total: dealer + payment + claim-task — matches the source). Console shows the expected expo-notifications web warning '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' — explicitly OK per the spec. Claim task data flow on /insurance-claims/74f1e3f0-8e08-4f82-bdde-d3d389153293: header link 'Tasks to Complete' now carries testID icd-tasks-link (the iter-65 instrumentation ask was implemented). The Tasks sheet opens via the icd-tasks-link tap (verified via .click()); inside the sheet 'Add Task' is reachable and the TaskModal renders with: 'Task' multiline field, 'Deadline (optional)' MM/DD/YYYY input, 'Remind me before the deadline' toggle (DEFAULT ON — matches TaskModal initial state notify=true at /app/frontend/app/insurance-claims/[id].tsx:855), and an 'Add Task' submit button. Notes-tab path: FAB on Notes tab opens 'Add Note' modal with Label dropdown, multiline Note field, 'Create a task from this note' toggle and 'Add Note' submit — confirmed present and rendering. No red screens, no pageerrors anywhere. Backend NOT tested per request (frontend-only). NOTE for main agent: Playwright force-click on the icd-tasks-link TouchableOpacity still does not trigger onPress reliably on react-native-web; a programmatic DOM .click() does. This is the same surface flagged in iter 65 and was confirmed unchanged here. The element itself looks correctly wired (no overlay, hitSlop 10pt, activeOpacity 0.7) so it's most likely an RN-web pointer-event-vs-Playwright force-click compat quirk rather than a real-user bug, but the symptom should be re-validated with a real touch on a device build.

ui_bugs.issue: Playwright force-click on the testID does not fire onPress (sheet does not open) — only DOM .click() works. Iter-65 instrumentation was added (testID, hitSlop, activeOpacity) but the symptom is still reproducible from automated tests. Likely RN-web TouchableOpacity vs Playwright pointer-event interop; suggest wrapping with Pressable + role='button' or hand-wiring an onClick passthrough for web to make it deterministic for automated regression tests. Real-device behavior should still be verified.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' — expected on web preview per spec, will only work on a real device build. Reference: /app/frontend/src/claimTaskReminders.ts.

Recurring deprecation warnings: 'textShadow*' (use textShadow), 'shadow*' (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)'. Not specific to this session's diff but worth a hygiene sweep.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Make icd-tasks-link click reliable from web/Playwright (Pressable or explicit web onClick) so the Tasks-to-Complete sheet can be opened from automated tests without falling back to a raw DOM click.

On a real iOS/Android dev build, verify (a) tapping 'Reminder time' under Claim task deadlines opens the time picker, (b) adding a claim task with a deadline + 'Remind me before the deadline' ON actually schedules a local notification (and a day-before one when claim_task_notify_day_before is on), and (c) toggling the group off cancels all tagged claim-task reminders. The web preview cannot fire local notifications — verified UI/data flow only.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/claimTaskReminders.ts — implementation matches the dealer/payment reminder pattern (tag-based cancel + reschedule, idempotent, web no-op via early return at line 74, 120-day horizon, day-of + optional day-before). LGTM.

/app/frontend/src/sections/NotificationsSettingsSection.tsx — the new 'Claim task deadlines' group is correctly placed AFTER payment and BEFORE the 'Send a test notification' row; all three required testIDs are present; iOS modal + Android picker branches mirror the dealer/payment pickers. File is 1118 lines (>700 guideline) — consider extracting per-group renderers (DealerGroup / BorrowGroup / PaymentGroup / ClaimTaskGroup) into separate files in /app/frontend/src/sections/notifications/.

/app/frontend/src/prefs.ts — new keys claim_task_notifications_enabled / claim_task_notification_hour / claim_task_notification_minute / claim_task_notify_day_before added with sensible defaults (true / 9 / 0 / true). Migration block at line 182 correctly includes claim_task_notifications_enabled in the legacy-master fallback. LGTM.

/app/frontend/app/insurance-claims/[id].tsx — TaskModal at line 851 defaults notify=true and persists via insuranceApi.addTask / patchTask({ notify }). Save handler calls rescheduleClaimTaskRemindersNow imported at line 24, but I do NOT see an explicit call to it after task add/edit/delete in the visible flow — the import is present (line 24) but main agent should double-check that save / patch / delete actually invoke rescheduleClaimTaskRemindersNow() so reminders stay in sync. (On web this is a no-op anyway; matters on device.)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — every spec'd surface rendered, all three new testIDs resolve, toggle on/off + time-row tap do not crash, claim-task TaskModal + Note-with-create-task render with all expected fields. Remaining 5%: icd-tasks-link force-click quirk (low) and end-to-end task-save couldn't be completed via Playwright because the ICDateField uses MM/DD/YYYY auto-mask which fought our YYYY-MM-DD typing — UI itself is fine.
